verdict.rationale: Rive is a design and animation editor, so a developer inspect/handoff mode is a fair axis to ask about. The evidence pack documents no layer-inspection feature, no generated CSS/iOS/Android snippets, and no free or viewer access for developers without an editor seat. Instead, Rive positions itself as eliminating handoff ('No mockups, no prototypes, no handoff') by shipping .riv files through runtimes. Runtimes, RML, and MCP are different capabilities and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can inspect any layer and get measurements, styles, assets, and code snippets (CSS/iOS/Android) without an editor seat
